Support for new moms and babies can’t begin and end at delivery. Here in Michigan, we’re providing extra support through Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies, community health programs, and expanded doula services to keep moms and babies healthy before, during, and after delivery.

Video

When we invest in these steps and in the people doing the work every day, we give every child the chance to grow into a confident reader and writer. And that’s not just good for students, it’s good for Michigan’s future.

Every Child Reads brings all of this together with a simple focus:

✏️ Start early

✏️ Use proven practices

✏️ Make sure kids get the support they need, when they need it

We’re expanding free pre‑K so they start strong and we’re using research‑backed reading instruction that works. Thousands of teachers have taken on advanced literacy training and we’re growing tutoring, after‑school, and weekend programs so our kids can get the support they need.

Strong literacy skills are the foundation that help kids make sense of the world, from solving everyday problems to imagining bold ideas. Across the country, students are struggling with reading. Michigan is no exception. 
But together, we're making meaningful progress.

Let’s come together to:

•Cap interest rates on medical debt.
•Prevent medical debt from showing up on your credit report. 
•Require hospitals to set up financial assistance programs for patients.
•And ban liens or foreclosures on homes because of medical debt.

Too many Michiganders have had to make the impossible choice of paying rent or seeing a doctor. No family deserves that.

We must do more to provide real relief from medical debt. Here’s how we do it ⬇️

For too many Michiganders, buying a home feels out of reach. There’s not enough housing and what is available is too expensive.

Michiganders want action to make housing more affordable and attainable. Let’s come together to cut red tape, streamline zoning, and Build, Baby Build.

Every woman in Michigan deserves access to the care, information, and support they need. That’s why, this Women’s Health Month, I sat down with our state’s Chief Medical Executive, Dr. Natasha Bagdasarian, to talk about what we’re doing to make sure Michigan women can thrive.

Video

Back in 1989, I walked this very stage. Rangers, today it’s your turn.
 
Show up, be kind, and build strong communities wherever you go. Your job is just to take the detours and enjoy the journey. You don’t have to know where you’re going… and that’s the best part.

Anti-abortion extremists will continue their nationwide assault on abortion and all forms of reproductive health care.

Every Michigander deserves the freedom to make their own decisions about their bodies, lives, and futures. I’ll keep fighting like hell to protect that freedom.

Today, the Supreme Court confirmed that mifepristone—a safe, effective, FDA-approved drug—can continue to be accessed nationwide through telehealth. While this is the right decision, it’s not the end of this fight.

Women’s Health Week is a chance to show what Michigan can achieve when we work together. We’ve expanded access to care, protected reproductive freedom, and strengthened support for families. I’m proud of how far we’ve come and I’m committed to building a healthier future.

No one should have to choose between paying the bills or getting the care they need. 
 
That’s why I:

✅Signed key parts of the ACA into Michigan law.
✅Made sure mental health is covered by law.
✅Passed a budget that protects the 2.5 million Michiganders who rely on Medicaid.

Video
